firstPlayerRule: The player with the most “hipster cred” goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from that player.
Solo mode uses a different sequence: build and score for yourself, then build and score for the Grifter, then draw your replacement Building.
interpretation: The rulebook does not define a measure for “hipster cred”; the group must agree how to apply it.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://sinisterfish.com/product/streets-retail-edition/. Finding: The player with the most “hipster cred” goes first. Local source SHA-256: 7f22a6a7da3d30cb2b923186c0f71c0bfbd23c9c5bc74dd05c4fbe24943ac3ec. The publisher's retail product links this 24-page base manual, whose back cover states ©2021. The subjective starter criterion is reproduced without inventing a metric or a tie-break. Solo turn-sequence steps 1–5 establish the human action before the Grifter. The separate promo-pack rules were not used. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Codex inspected rendered source pages, edition, setup versus action sequence, relevant solo and two-player context, and source references. The owner authorized factual review on 2026-09-22 in task Reload localhost. Included in the random mix: the main criterion selects an individual starter without game-specific components. Moon's preliminary production does not replace its sequential first Construction turn; Streets' subjective criterion is explicitly identified as undefined.
